feeling: A small machine's tune is wound faster and faster until it wrecks the room, stops, and comes back the size of a star.
intent: Zappy at full scale, for zappy's own video, in the darker key with the half step glass-hour uses: the five notes stated, built with brass chords and drums over four steps up in tempo, a break of near silence, and a return larger than the first statement. Nobody has heard it: it was checked by measurement only.
listen_for: The tune turning from bright to dark at 0:08; the hammering from 0:28; the near silence at 0:42 with only a clock and the little tune; and the same tune at half speed with everything under it at 0:49.

parts.name: plain
parts.change: the five notes alone over a ticking clock; a deep floor under the last
parts.feels: small and sure of itself, then told otherwise

parts.name: build
parts.change: the bass starts to run, a kick, brass chords; the tempo steps up

parts.name: faster
parts.change: the tune at double speed, each bar starting higher; a snare roll

parts.name: destruction
parts.change: the fastest tempo; three notes of the tune hammered in octaves, chords a half step apart

parts.name: silence
parts.change: a slow clock and the five notes, very quiet, alone

parts.name: return
parts.change: the tune at half speed in octaves over the lowest bass and full chords
parts.feels: the real size of it: vast, and not kind
